verdict.rationale: Martin is built around natural-language operation. The docs repeatedly describe telling Martin to manage calendar events, emails, Slack messages, reminders, to-dos and notes, and he is reachable by phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email and Slack. A hands-on user corroborates that it handled complicated requests correctly the first time. missing for 10: evidence that setup and configuration (e.g., Todoist import, which is done in the web app Settings) can also be done by natural-language command.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once connected, you can tell Martin to add an event to your calendar, and he will add it at the specified time with the specified details.
Call Martin and say "Note down everything we talked about on this call and call it 'Brain Dump'."
Martin is reachable through all your communication channels, including phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and Slack.
You can tell Martin to add, edit, and check off your to-dos on your behalf from any interface.
it’s handling some complicated requests correctly the first time
